''Bachoy'' ([[Spanish language in the Philippines|Spanish]]) | country = [[Philippines]] | region = [[La Paz, Iloilo City|La Paz]], [[Iloilo City]] | creator = | course = [[Soup]] | served = Hot | main_ingredient = [[Noodle]]s, [[pork]] organs, [[vegetable]]s, [[Chicken as food|chicken]], [[Shrimp and prawn as food|shrimp]], [[beef]] | variations = Batchoy Tagalog, Bumbay | calories = | other = }} '''Batchoy''', alternatively spelled '''batsoy''' ({{IPA|tl|ˈbatʃoɪ|}}), is a [[Filipino cuisine|Filipino]] [[noodle soup]] of [[pork]] [[offal]], crushed pork [[Pork rind|cracklings]], [[Chicken as food|chicken]] [[Stock (food)|stock]], [[beef]] loin, and round [[noodle]]s. The original and most popular variant, '''La Paz batchoy''', traces its roots to the [[Iloilo City]] [[Districts of Iloilo City|district]] of [[La Paz, Iloilo City|La Paz]], in the [[Philippines]].
